title: Valid Digit Number
goal: Solve Valid Digit Number: Scan decimal digits, test the leading-digit restriction, and combine both conditions.
strategy: Scan decimal digits, test the leading-digit restriction, and combine both conditions.

phasePurposes.start: Convert the number to its decimal digits.
phasePurposes.scan: Track whether any scanned digit matches x.
phasePurposes.leading: The leading digit must differ from x.

edgeCases: The target digit must occur but must not be the leading digit. Zero is represented by a single zero, so n=0 and x=0 fails the leading-digit rule.
inputRules: Enter {"n":101,"x":0}: integer n from 0 to 100,000 and digit x from 0 to 9.
